components: Solve unknown per-port additive invariants from translated contacts, not by fitting an exponent. Compare valences two, three and four, finite integer windows, rational half meshes, alternative nonlinear behavior and bounded errors.
candidates.declared_status: Signed quadratic plus linear plus constant on the rational contact contract. Even dark response selects the square up to scale; it could still be zero and is not a click law.
missing_bridges: Derive signed linear port dynamics and demonstrate additive independent, calibrated detector responses across backgrounds.

components: Construct normalized translated background tests by finite four-port words with a separate sign spare. Solve finite unknown tables and compare two dyadic spectator ideals at a fixed target amplitude.
candidates.declared_status: No arbitrary state oracle is needed for the tested dyadic preparations; detector separability is independent of preparation reachability.
missing_bridges: Test the assumption that a local detector ignores spectator arithmetic and hidden preparation history.

components: Use the same reciprocal port rule to divide an integer signal into its square number of equal-magnitude branches. Check inverse, interference sign controls, maximum arity limits and branch-dependent efficiency.
candidates.declared_status: A constructive rational fine-graining gives squared branch counts. Equating complete equal-leaf events and stable grouped outcomes is an extra physical assumption.
missing_bridges: Bind mode count, signed swaps, raw event exclusivity and grouping to a reusable internal detector.

components: Compile exact rational reflections with explicit sign and vacuum resources. Factor arbitrary rational orthogonal matrices; physically leave a named spectator untouched in a complement match.
candidates.declared_status: Exact real-linear synthesis with arbitrary port degree and routing is not a derivation of linearity or detectors. No fixed finite rational alphabet gives all denominator primes.
missing_bridges: Derive or constrain signed controls, reservoir size and the physical equivalence of different preparation words.

components: Retain a symmetry-respecting nonlinear involution which agrees on all two-level additive and branch-split tests, and distinguish it by one reachable three-level input after a shared preparation.
candidates.declared_status: Conserving the square does not identify the linear contact. Predictions for a selected unconditioned output-power fraction differ by five sixths.
missing_bridges: Meter incident and emitted powers, phases and losses on the same hardware; input-output calibration is not single-event confirmation.
